column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST: one subtest per dialect, so mysql and mssql skip in this PostgreSQL-only job while postgres RUNS -- two, not three. Measured by NAME with only CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES set (skipped: /mssql, /mysql), not derived from a delta and not counted with all three DSNs set, where it would read zero. Guards the management half of cleat#1565: an egress allowlist nobody can write is a table rather than a policy, which is the state tenant_settings sat in for months (cleat#1187). It is declared here rather than left in the __UNATTRIBUTED__ budget because the ported.go entry claiming all three dialects is supposed to have a test behind it, and a skip that nobody named is not that test.
